scenes.head: Same tax group: e‑invoicing from January?
scenes.sub: Two companies, one invoice between them.
scenes.say: Two companies in the same tax group: does an invoice between them need e-invoicing from January twenty twenty-seven? For two years, no.

scenes.say: Under Ministerial Decision one ninety-seven of twenty twenty-six, these transactions are excluded for twenty-four months, from the first of January, twenty twenty-seven.

items.l: Tax Procedures Law retention still applies

scenes.say: The decision also drops the rule to store e-invoice data in the UAE, and the system-failure notice.
